rules.recommendation: Node {node}: possible connection scan. Evidence: {features}. Review the source peer and rate-limit new connections only if this traffic is not expected.

rules.name: dos_flood-like
rules.recommendation: Node {node}: possible traffic flood. Evidence: {features}. Check traffic source and node load; apply a temporary traffic limit if the burst is not expected.

rules.name: resource_exhaustion-like
rules.recommendation: Node {node}: possible resource exhaustion. Evidence: {features}. Check processes, open connections, memory, and CPU before taking action.

rules.name: proto_violation-like
rules.recommendation: Node {node}: unusual protocol or error activity. Evidence: {features}. Review protocol, policy, and audit logs for this time window.

rules.name: peer_anomaly-like
rules.recommendation: Node {node}: unusual peer or relay activity. Evidence: {features}. Check peer membership and relay connectivity.
